name: State of Mind
source:
Couriers are special envoys tasked with assisting others on a mysterious island and beyond.
Very few survive their training before being put on active duty. You play as one of these couriers.​

[From F95Zone]
translation:
信使是特使，其任务是协助神秘岛屿及其他地方的其他人。
很少有人能在训练结束后投入现役。你扮演这些信使之一。​

[来自F95Zone]
